items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: by the time I joined his band and went to Chicago... I had a good time in Tiny's band

ctx.x: All right, now back to Tiny Bradshaw.

Oh, Tiny Bradshaw, oh, yes. I liked Tiny. Tiny was a -- he was a good kid. He was a sort of a drummer. He wasn't a great or even a good drummer, and by the time I joined his band and went to Chicago, he was just directing the band. And he could dance and sing and sort of a takeoff on Cab Calloway type of thing, and I had -- then again I say I had -- I had a good time in Tiny's band, because he was a fun guy. He liked to have a good time and he liked automobiles, he liked cars, you know, he liked to drive and that…
and so, and he'd get the music, you know, and I could work out on it on my clarinet. That sort of thing.
